label: 4j
title: The problem and the answer: what the whole industry faces, and how Omni-Compass addresses it
grade_changes: mechanism B -> B-: the coupling rule ('a step on one muscle stands only while every muscle it couples to stays inside its own cushion') is stated twice, in the prose and in the table, as a hard rule. The engine has no such pairwise check. omnicompass/nervous_system.py grants 'expand' to every organ except during a security hold, and gates 'contract' by one shared calm scalar. Only a few specific cross-organ gates exist (heat forces the cpufreq/GPU ceilings, power stress gates batch admission). This misstates the mechanism; it is not merely loose.
